description: This file defines a TypeScript class 'ClaudeApi' implementing the 'LLMApi' interface for interacting with the Anthropic Claude language model. It includes type definitions for chat requests and responses, utility functions, and imports external modules for API calls, state management, and utilities. The class handles streaming and non-streaming chat interactions, constructs request payloads, and manages API endpoints.

classes.name: ClaudeApi
classes.description: A class implementing the LLMApi interface for interacting with the Anthropic Claude model, supporting chat functionalities with streaming and non-streaming options.

methods.name: extractMessage
methods.description: Extracts the message text from the API response object.

methods.name: chat
methods.description: Performs a chat interaction with the model, handling request construction, streaming, and response processing.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Returns usage statistics, currently a placeholder with zero values.

methods.name: models
methods.description: Returns a list of available models, currently empty.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Constructs the API endpoint URL based on configuration and input path.
